title: Transport in Matsumoto City — Matsumoto City Official Tourism Website

facts.fact: The Town Sneaker city loop bus uses the railway station Castle/East Exit rotary; the separate Matsumoto Bus Terminal handles the described long-distance routes.
The guide distinguishes the rail-station rotary from Matsumoto Bus Terminal, which it describes as a separate nearby location.
facts.excerpt: Matsumoto Bus Terminal, a two-minute walk from the station.

facts.fact: Bus boarding doors and payment rules vary by service; current city and long-distance routes should not be assumed identical.
facts.excerpt: different boarding rules and payment methods depending on the type of vehicle.
